events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: The legendary comedian, actor, and writer John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: Comedy Legend
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th to the one and only John Cleese! From Monty Python to Fawlty Towers, his comedic genius is timeless.

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' Anniversary
events.blurb: It's 58 years since The Beatles released their iconic self-titled double album, commonly known as 'The White Album', in 1968.

angles.name: White Album Legacy
angles.copy: 58 years since The Beatles gave us the 'White Album'. A sprawling masterpiece that still sounds incredible today. What's your favourite track?

events.title: Remembering Freddie Mercury
events.blurb: Today marks 35 years since the passing of Queen frontman Freddie Mercury, who would have been 80 this year.

angles.name: Legendary Voice
angles.copy: 35 years on, Freddie Mercury's voice and stage presence remain unmatched. A true icon who would have been 80 this year. Forever missed.

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' Anniversary
events.blurb: 59 years ago today, The Beatles released their groundbreaking album 'Rubber Soul' in 1965.

angles.name: Rubber Soul Vibe
angles.copy: 59 years of 'Rubber Soul'! The Beatles' classic album that truly pushed boundaries. Still sounds fresh.

events.title: Remembering John Lennon
events.blurb: Today marks 46 years since the tragic death of The Beatles icon John Lennon, who would have been 86 this year.

angles.name: Imagine Peace
angles.copy: 46 years since we lost John Lennon. His music and message of peace live on, especially today, when he would have been 86.

events.title: David Bowie would have been 80
events.blurb: The legendary 'Starman' David Bowie would have celebrated his 80th birthday today.

angles.name: Bowie's Legacy
angles.copy: Remembering the incredible David Bowie, who would have turned 80 today. His artistry and influence are truly immortal.

events.title: Elvis Presley would have been 92
events.blurb: The King of Rock and Roll, Elvis Presley, would have celebrated his 92nd birthday today.

angles.name: Long Live The King
angles.copy: The King would have been 92 today! Elvis Presley's music continues to define generations. What's your favourite Elvis track?

events.title: Jimmy Page turns 83
events.blurb: Led Zeppelin guitarist and rock legend Jimmy Page celebrates his 83rd birthday today.

angles.name: Guitar God
angles.copy: Happy 83rd birthday to the incomparable Jimmy Page! The riff master behind Led Zeppelin's greatest hits.

events.title: Rod Stewart turns 82
events.blurb: The iconic British singer and songwriter Sir Rod Stewart celebrates his 82nd birthday today.

angles.name: Forever Young
angles.copy: Happy 82nd to the legendary Rod Stewart! What's your favourite song from his incredible career?

events.title: Suggs turns 66
events.blurb: Madness frontman and British music icon Suggs (Graham McPherson) celebrates his 66th birthday today.

angles.name: Madness Legend
angles.copy: Happy 66th birthday to the one and only Suggs! The voice of Madness, still bringing the good times.

events.title: Paul Young turns 71
events.blurb: The British pop and soul singer Paul Young celebrates his 71st birthday today.

angles.name: 80s Soul Voice
angles.copy: Happy 71st birthday to Paul Young! That distinctive voice gave us so many 80s classics.

events.title: Dolly Parton turns 81
events.blurb: The Queen of Country, Dolly Parton, celebrates her 81st birthday today.

angles.name: Dolly's World
angles.copy: Happy 81st birthday to the iconic Dolly Parton! A true legend whose music and philanthropy inspire millions.

events.title: Gary Barlow turns 56
events.blurb: Take That frontman and acclaimed songwriter Gary Barlow celebrates his 56th birthday today.

angles.name: Take That Legend
angles.copy: Happy 56th birthday to Gary Barlow! From Take That to his solo success, a true British music institution.

events.title: Billy Ocean turns 77
events.blurb: The Trinidadian-British singer Billy Ocean celebrates his 77th birthday today.

angles.name: Caribbean Queen
angles.copy: Happy 77th birthday to the brilliant Billy Ocean! His timeless hits still get us dancing.

events.title: Rock & Roll Hall of Fame's first ceremony
events.blurb: It's 38 years since the very first Rock and Roll Hall of Fame induction ceremony was held in 1989.

angles.name: Music History
angles.copy: 38 years ago, the Rock & Roll Hall of Fame held its first induction ceremony. A landmark moment celebrating music's greatest.

events.title: Mark Owen turns 55
events.blurb: Take That member Mark Owen celebrates his 55th birthday today.

angles.name: Take That Star
angles.copy: Happy 55th birthday to Mark Owen! Still charming audiences after all these years with Take That.

events.title: The Beatles' iconic Rooftop Concert
events.blurb: 58 years ago today, The Beatles performed their legendary final public performance on the rooftop of Apple Corps in 1969.

angles.name: Rooftop Magic
angles.copy: 58 years since THAT rooftop concert. The Beatles' final live performance, a moment etched in music history.

events.title: Phil Collins turns 76
events.blurb: The legendary Genesis drummer and solo superstar Phil Collins celebrates his 76th birthday today.

angles.name: In The Air Tonight
angles.copy: Happy 76th birthday to the one and only Phil Collins! A true musical powerhouse.

events.title: Justin Timberlake turns 46
events.blurb: The pop superstar, actor, and former NSYNC member Justin Timberlake celebrates his 46th birthday today.

angles.name: JT Turns 46
angles.copy: Happy 46th birthday to Justin Timberlake! From boyband heartthrob to solo sensation, he's still bringing the moves and the hits.

events.title: Sir David Jason turns 87
events.blurb: The beloved British actor Sir David Jason, famous for roles like Del Boy and Jack Frost, celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: National Treasure
angles.copy: Happy 87th birthday to the legendary Sir David Jason! A true national treasure who has given us countless iconic characters. Lovely jubbly!

events.title: The Day The Music Died Anniversary
events.blurb: Today marks 68 years since the tragic plane crash in 1959 that claimed the lives of Buddy Holly, Ritchie Valens, and The Big Bopper.

angles.name: Never Forgotten
angles.copy: 68 years ago, 'The Day The Music Died'. Remembering Buddy Holly, Ritchie Valens, and The Big Bopper, whose legacies live on.

events.title: Rick Astley turns 61
events.blurb: The British pop singer Rick Astley, famous for his 80s hits and viral comeback, celebrates his 61st birthday today.

angles.name: Never Gonna Give You Up
angles.copy: Happy 61st birthday to Rick Astley! Still 'Never Gonna Give You Up' on his infectious pop tunes.

events.title: Bob Marley would have been 82
events.blurb: The reggae icon Bob Marley would have celebrated his 82nd birthday today.

angles.name: One Love
angles.copy: Remembering the legendary Bob Marley, who would have been 82 today. His message of 'One Love' resonates louder than ever.

events.title: Carole King turns 85
events.blurb: The legendary American singer-songwriter Carole King celebrates her 85th birthday today.

angles.name: Tapestry of Talent
angles.copy: Happy 85th birthday to the incredible Carole King! A songwriting genius and a true voice of a generation.

events.title: Remembering Whitney Houston
events.blurb: Today marks 15 years since the passing of the incomparable 'Voice', Whitney Houston, who would have been 64 this year.

angles.name: The Voice Remembered
angles.copy: 15 years since we lost 'The Voice'. Remembering Whitney Houston, whose incredible talent continues to inspire. She would have been 64.

events.title: Take That's original split anniversary
events.blurb: It's 32 years since the day in 1995 when Take That announced their original split, breaking hearts across the nation.

angles.name: Heartbreak Day
angles.copy: 32 years ago today, a nation mourned as Take That announced their split. Thankfully, they came back stronger!
